You are building AUTHENTICATION UI + registration for a Next.js 16 clone of naano.com. Repo: /Users/raju/work/assignment-8x. Auth.js v5 (next-auth beta) with a credentials provider is ALREADY configured in src/auth.ts — do NOT modify it.

STEP 1 — Read /Users/raju/work/assignment-8x/docs/AGENT_KIT.md IN FULL and obey its shared components, conventions, and HARD RULES. Also read src/auth.ts, src/lib/auth-helpers.ts, src/lib/password.ts, src/lib/auth-service.ts, src/lib/rate-limit.ts, and src/lib/constants.ts to understand what exists. @/ = src/.

YOUR ASSIGNED FILES (create only these):
- src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx  (uses the (auth) group layout which already renders a centered card container + logo)
- src/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx
- src/app/actions/register.ts  (server action(s): "use server")
- src/app/actions/login.ts      (server action for credentials sign-in)
- src/app/onboarding/company/page.tsx, src/app/onboarding/creator/page.tsx, src/app/onboarding/agency/page.tsx  (+ their own layout src/app/onboarding/layout.tsx that calls requireAuth() and centers content — fallback profile creation for authed users missing a profile)
- Client form components under src/components/auth/ (LoginForm, RegisterForm) as needed.

LOGIN (src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx):
- Card with heading "Welcome back", email + password fields (use Field/Input/Label), submit button "Sign in".
- Use a client LoginForm that calls a server action in src/app/actions/login.ts. That action: validate with zod; call `signIn("credentials", { email, password, redirect: false })` from @/auth inside try/catch. On failure (AuthError / thrown), return `{ error: "Invalid email or password" }` (generic — no user enumeration). On success, `redirect("/app")`. IMPORTANT: redirecting to "/app" is fine for ALL roles because the /app layout auto-forwards non-company users to their own dashboard via requireRole. (Note: next-auth may throw a redirect internally; if you use redirect:false you must call Next's redirect("/app") yourself after success. Handle the NEXT_REDIRECT rethrow correctly — don't swallow it.)
- Add a "Demo accounts" panel with 4 one-click buttons that sign in as company@naano.test / creator@naano.test / agency@naano.test / talent@naano.test (all password "password123"). Implement each as a form posting to a server action (or the same login action with hidden fields) — this is a huge convenience for the reviewer. Label them clearly (Company, Creator, Brand agency, Creator agency).
- Link to /register.

REGISTER (src/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx):
- Reads searchParams `?role=company|creator|agency`. If no role, show role-selection cards: heading "First, who are you here as?" subhead "One platform. Two sides." — three cards: "I'm a brand" (company), "I'm a creator", "I'm an agency", each linking to /register?role=<x>.
- Once a role is chosen, show the registration form (name, email, password, plus one role-specific field: company → companyName; creator → displayName + headline; agency → agencyName + agency type select BRAND_AGENCY/CREATOR_AGENCY). "Free to start. No credit card required."
- Submit calls src/app/actions/register.ts `registerUser`. That action MUST: validate with zod; the role field is restricted to COMPANY|CREATOR|AGENCY (NEVER accept ADMIN — mass-assignment safe, pick fields explicitly); rate-limit by IP/email using checkRateLimit; check email uniqueness (return a friendly error if taken); hash the password with hashPassword from @/lib/password; create the User AND a minimal matching profile (CompanyProfile{companyName} / CreatorProfile{displayName, headline, bio:"", location:"", followers:0, medianReach:0, engagementRate:0, avgReactions:0, avgComments:0, pricePerPost:100, verticals:[], audienceByFunction:{}, audienceBySeniority:{}} / AgencyProfile{agencyName, type}) in a single prisma transaction; then sign the user in via signIn("credentials", {email,password, redirect:false}) and redirect to roleHome(role). Log via @/lib/logger (never log the password).
- Note: CreatorProfile requires audienceByFunction/audienceBySeniority (Json, required) — pass empty objects {}. Provide sensible defaults for required numeric fields.

ONBOARDING: minimal forms to complete a profile if an authed user somehow lacks one (the app layouts redirect here). Each posts to a server action (you can put these in register.ts or a new src/app/actions/onboarding.ts) that creates the profile for the current user then redirects to their dashboard. Enforce that the profile doesn't already exist.

SECURITY: all server actions validate input (zod), enforce that role can't be escalated, never expose secrets, and use generic auth errors. All must typecheck — run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix errors in YOUR files.

Return a concise report of files created, and confirm the login→dashboard and register→dashboard flows.

6	
7	- **Do NOT modify** any of these (they are shared & stable): `src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`, `package.json`, anything in `prisma/`, anything in `src/lib/`, `src/components/ui/*`, `src/components/logo.tsx`, `src/components/marketing/site-nav.tsx`, `src/components/marketing/site-footer.tsx`, `src/components/app/*`, `src/auth.ts`, and the route-group layouts (`src/app/(marketing)/layout.tsx`, `src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx`, `src/app/app/layout.tsx`, `src/app/creator/layout.tsx`, `src/app/agency/layout.tsx`). Create **new files only, in your assigned directories.**
8	- **Do NOT run** `npm install`, `npm run dev`, or `npm run build`. All deps are installed; the orchestrator verifies centrally. You MAY run `npx tsc --noEmit` to check types if useful, but it's optional.
9	- If you think you need a new npm package, DON'T — use what's installed (recharts, lucide-react, zod, date-fns, ai, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority) or note it in your final report.
10	- Path alias: `@/` → `src/`.
11	
12	## Stack conventions
13	
14	- **Server Components by default.** Add `"use client"` only for interactivity (state, event handlers, hooks).
15	- **Async params/searchParams** (Next 16): `export default async function Page({ params, searchParams }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }>; searchParams: Promise<Record<string,string|undefined>> }) { const { id } = await params; }`
16	- **Do NOT use** the global `LayoutProps`/`PageProps` types (they break standalone typecheck) — type props explicitly as shown above.
17	- **DB access** via `import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"`. Always scope queries to the authenticated user (never trust client-supplied ids for ownership) — IDOR-safe. Return/redirect (404-style) if a record isn't owned by the current user.
18	- **Mutations** = server actions in `src/app/actions/<name>.ts` starting with `"use server"`. Validate inputs with `zod`. Call `revalidatePath(...)` after writes. Enforce role/ownership inside the action (default-deny) — never rely on the UI hiding a control.
19	- **Money** is stored as whole euros (integer). Render with `formatEuros`.
20	- **Security guardrails to honor**: server-side authz on every action/route; validate all external input with zod; never put secrets in code; rely on React's auto-escaping (never `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with user/AI data); use explicit DTOs (don't spread a whole request body into a Prisma create — pick allowed fields).
